node.title: The 218-plane pure-power endpoint reduces to degrees 2048 and 4096
node.closure: exact integer routing of the pure-power quotient-periodic subclass
node.statement: Assume the residual projective direction pencil of the proved 218-plane bank is projectively equivalent on mu_N to (X^e,1), where e is a power-of-two divisor of N and e<=K'-1. Then e is 2048 or 4096. Degree 2048 forces K'=2049, all 218 directions and lines, and at most 72 missing fiber slots. Degree 4096 forces 4097<=K'<=4237, at least 211 directions, at most seven duplicate-direction lines, and at most 28744 missing slots. This classifies neither the general rational map nor the surviving cases.
